subject.title: [Refactor] Extract canonical configuration validation from core to plugin boundaries

question: Does current main still contain a specific plugin- or channel-owned configuration schema that maintainers want moved out of core, or should this broad refactor request close as already satisfied by the manifest-first contract?
rationale: Current docs and merged history already establish the requested ownership model, but only a maintainer can confirm whether a known residual schema is intentionally still core-owned or should become a narrowly scoped follow-up.

options.title: Close as already covered
options.body: Close this issue because no concrete residual schema is identified and current main already validates plugin and channel config from manifest-owned metadata.

options.title: Name a narrow residual
options.body: Keep the issue open only after identifying one exact core-owned schema, its intended plugin owner, and the validation test that should move with it.

recommendation.title: Close as already covered
recommendation.body: Close this issue because no concrete residual schema is identified and current main already validates plugin and channel config from manifest-owned metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows ownership of the plugin architecture boundary and its manifest-first documentation.
